requirements.rule: Admit only an independently registered, approved, versioned horizon policy with exact identity, content fingerprint, selection and effectivity evidence; a number, caller assertion or self-hash is not authority.
Original decision cutoff D is mandatory. Selection, approval, applicability, routing and decision-input event/known times must be <= D. Research run time R never selects the horizon.

Use the exact predecessor/native policy validity verifier, including its documented inclusive/exclusive end semantics. No new universal effective-to convention; unavailable convention fails closed. Equal eligible conflicts cannot be selected by input order.

Resolved start equals original D. The economic contract's start_at_decision is stricter than the paired protocol's D <= start constraint; satisfying both means start=D. Future executable fills, signal detection and next-session timestamps cannot replace D.
Endpoint must be strictly after D, uniquely derived by the approved D-bound unit/mapping/counting/precision/terminal policy and D-visible calendar closure; none are silently supplied here.
A pair pins one exact full HorizonBinding, reused identically by both legs. Challenger tactical context and incumbent elapsed holding cannot select separate horizons.
No expiry, paper window, actual holding period, calibration window, review cadence, event lag, Gate6 blackout or bar timeframe can automatically provide the duration.
Categorical routing can be evidence only. Without an explicit approved applicability/unit/value/counting mapping emit HORIZON_MAPPING_POLICY_REQUIRED, not a guessed duration or midpoint.

A future authority must name supported strategy/archetype/routing/signal/instrument/state scope and same-horizon suitability for both legs. Unsupported or missing original routing fails closed. No universal horizon is approved.

Pin original policy ID/version/fingerprint, input closure, D and resolution. Later policy versions/corrections cannot rewrite existing observations or reselect after outcomes; retain immutable successors with distinct lineage.

Current protocol requires one selected bound horizon per paired observation. No numeric grid/fan-out is authorized here. Any future multiple-observation design must freeze all horizon selections and grouping/splits before forward outcomes; never choose the best realized result.

Only after R >= exact endpoint, canonical terminal session/phase completion proof known by R, and eligible outcome evidence known by R may the predecessor admit a label. Missing exact terminal evidence remains pending/unresolved/excluded with null label, never zero-return fallback.

Research-only approval must be explicitly scoped. Conceptual common-horizon consistency with future live economics is desirable, but registration for research cannot activate V2 or grant scenario/producer/broker authority.

Validate raw source identities/fingerprints with their native schemes before normalization. Reject tampering and conflicting lineage; retain exact duplicate aliases once under predecessor receipts, not as multiple authorities.

A later frozen replay run/receipt may exist only under predecessor administrative-metadata rules; it cannot backdate approval, supply future decision features, mint an original portfolio event or repair missing horizon authority.
No new TTL is invented. Check exact policy validity, revocation, supersession and source freshness as of D under approved rules; undefined/ambiguous validity cannot become authority.

recommended_owner: Future Gate1 paired-research governance policy/resolver using existing canonical routing and factual calendar contracts; not B09, AI, signal expiry, paper engine or a parallel calendar. Ownership recommendation only; no module or registration added.

boundaries.calendar_admission: Reuse exact D-visible annual holiday, weekday convention, special-day, effective phase, exchange and segment source closure; source hashes do not establish approval.

Market open does not prove instrument tradability. Preserve horizon; unavailable exact terminal observation excludes label.
Null outcome/unavailable, not nearest future price, carry-forward or zero return.
Require exact canonical terminal entitlement/value under separately governed methodology; do not drop delisted losers or invent cash settlement.
Existing immutable parcel/adjustment/identity lineage and comparable terminal evidence required; no horizon shortening/extension.

Later unexpected closure cannot rewrite frozen D-bound endpoint. Completion/outcome unresolved or excluded until governed evidence exists; any alternative terminal convention needs separate prospective policy.

provenance.reuse: Predecessor PolicyRef, SourceRef, HorizonBinding and DecisionSnapshot; future typed extension for routing/mapping/representation only after policy definition. Do not alter predecessor wire schema.
provenance.identity: Predecessor observation identity unchanged. A future horizon resolution identity would bind authority/version, original event/comparison, pair, D and verified ordered input references; exact new wire algorithm deferred until policy definition.
provenance.content_fingerprint: Existing HorizonBinding fingerprint remains SHA256 repository canonical_json of its full normalized body excluding only fingerprint. Any future expanded resolution requires a separately versioned scheme, not omitted fields or reinterpretation of predecessor hash.
provenance.normalization: UTC aware timestamps; exact typed units/decimals if later approved; ordered references by role/id/version; native source fingerprint verified first. No locale, unordered sets or wall clock.

maturity.rule: R >= frozen end AND canonical exact terminal session/phase completed AND proof known_at <= R; eligible label evidence known_at <= R.
maturity.oos: Only admissible mature labels under predecessor frozen methodology/splits; no overlapping future labels in selection.
